title: 九天应元雷声普化天尊双面挂件
summary: 一面人物图像，一面尊号文字，两种表达呈现雷祖主题。
summary_en: A figure on one side and a sacred title on the other express the Thunder Ancestor theme.
body:
图片以并列方式展示这款雷祖主题挂件的两面：一面是人物与座下纹样，另一面为「九天应元雷声普化天尊」文字及红色装饰线条。正反两面的图像与文字相互呼应，适合欣赏传统图像与书写的结合。

「辟邪」是原图使用的传统宗教表述，在此作为文化寓意介绍，不作具体效果的保证。图片展示双面设计，不代表订单含两枚挂件。
body_en:
The supplied photograph presents both sides of this Thunder Ancestor design: a figure with a decorative base on one side, and the title Jiutian Yingyuan Leisheng Puhua Tianzun with red accents on the other. Image and inscription create a complementary visual pairing.

The source photograph uses “evil-warding” as traditional religious language. It is presented here as cultural symbolism, not a guarantee. The two views describe a double-sided design, not an order containing two pendants.
